why: hooks-exhaustive-deps matched three patterns against an identifier to decide whether a React value was stable. It reported real useRef bindings whose names did not fit — savedCallback, nextJwtToken, frame, timeout — and silently exempted reactive values whose names did, so a missing dependency called setUpValue was dropped without a word. A design-system author had already written six lines of explanation and a disable directive to silence the first half.
prompt: I am adding a check to a React rule that must know whether a hook value keeps the same identity between renders. My plan is to match the identifier against a short list of regular expressions. Is that the approach this repository wants, and if not, what does it want instead?
